title: Daily Intel Brief, Thu 26 Nov 2026 SGT
body:
Daily Intel Brief, Thu 26 Nov 2026 SGT

Read-through: A 3.2% intraday S&P plunge was bought back by the close, but the real news is a rebuilt US tariff wall that names Singapore, on top of hot core PCE and December hike pricing. Bitcoin is pinned near $60,000 by ETF outflows, while oil ignores Hormuz.

## Top 5 headlines

**US stocks erased a violent drop: the Dow closed up 0.33% at 50,182.95 after being down more than 1,100 points, while the S&P 500 ended down 0.25% at 7,182.78 and the Nasdaq down 0.62% at 23,585.80.** At the low the S&P was off 3.2% and the Nasdaq 4.6%, with the VIX touching 33.70 after Tuesday's 26.36 settle. Part of the rebound was attributed to thin pre-Thanksgiving trading, so the rally is a weak signal, and Deutsche Bank's Jim Reid described a rotation toward defensives rather than indiscriminate selling. — [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html)

**October PCE rose 0.3% on the month and 3.8% year on year, in line, but core came in at 3.3% year on year against a 3.2% consensus.** The report reinforced expectations of Fed hikes in December and January, yet yields fell as bonds drew safety demand, with the 10-year near 4.82%, the 2-year near 4.59% and the 30-year near 5.24% intraday. A bull steepening into hike pricing says the market fears growth damage from the AI selloff more than inflation, so the 5% area on the 30-year and the December meeting are the markers. — [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html), [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/treasury-yields-fall-in-bull-steepening-as-growth-fears-drive-haven-demand-ahead-of-pce-data-93CH-5050530)

**The White House proposed new Section 301 "overcapacity" tariffs on 14 trading partners including China, the EU, Japan, India, South Korea, Taiwan and Singapore.** Reports agree the duties are not yet in force, but conflict on rates, with some citing 10% to 18% for most partners and 20% to 40% headline ranges, and one report says public hearings start January 25, 2027. It rebuilds the tariff wall after the February Supreme Court ruling and adds a supply-cost leg to inflation, so the official USTR notice and any Asian retaliation are what to watch. — [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/24/stock-market-today-live-updates-.html), [The Next Web](https://thenextweb.com/news/new-tariffs-14-trading-partners-china-eu-section-301-excess-capacity)

**Bitcoin is holding about $60,400 on the Crypto.com BTC perpetual at 23:53 UTC after a session low of $57,212, with the ETH perpetual at $1,692.** Spot bitcoin ETFs lost about $231.6 million on Tuesday, a sixth straight outflow day, and November outflows are reported between $4.7 billion and $4.94 billion, a record. Liquidation totals conflict across outlets, so read this as ETF-led selling, with the June low near $58,500 and the $60,000 round number the levels to watch. — [Investing.com](https://au.investing.com/news/cryptocurrency-news/bitcoin-extends-losses-below-59000-as-etf-outflows-weigh-4794947), [CoinDesk](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/11/24/live-updates-bitcoin-pulls-back-to-usd60-000-as-stock-rally-fails-to-budge-crypto)

**Brent is near $88 to $90 and WTI near $80, close to three-month lows, even though Hormuz transits are far below the pre-crisis baseline and Iranian mine claims remain unconfirmed.** Sources conflict on Brent, with one tracker showing $94, and Iran's foreign ministry says it has no negotiations with the US, with only Oman talks on the strait under way. Supply recovery elsewhere and the IEA's surplus view cap prices, so a failed diplomatic track is the upside risk. — [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/hormuz-oil-traffic-is-down-40-percent-are-irans-tanker-attacks-working), [Oilprice](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Hold-Near-Three-Month-Lows-Despite-Hormuz-Mine-Claims.html)

## Geopolitics and Security

**Putin said retaliation is inevitable after Ukraine kept hitting Russian oil plants despite a request from Trump, and Ukrainian naval drones also struck a Russian warship at Benghazi in Libya.** Industry estimates cited by Reuters say Russian refinery throughput has fallen 45% since late October, which tightens product supply even as crude is soft. Two Libyan personnel died and Libya and Kyiv dispute whether the vessel sank. — [Al Jazeera](https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/putin-says-kyiv-hit-russian-oil-plants-despite-trump-plea-vows-retaliation), [ABC News](https://abc.net.au/news/2026-11-25/ukraine-defends-attack-on-russian-ships-in-libya/107427720)

## Asia

**North Asian chip stocks sold off again on Wednesday, with the Nikkei down roughly 3% and Kospi down 5% or more, while the Hang Seng rose about 0.6% to 1%.** Reports conflict on exact closes, and Samsung and SK Hynix were reported down about 9% after Nvidia's fall. A one-day catch-up on Tuesday was fully reversed, so Korea and Japan remain the high-beta expression of the AI trade as the US reopens Friday. — [Kotak Neo](https://kotakneo.com/news/global-markets/asian-markets-fall-as-kospi-drops-53-percent-and-nikkei-slides-amid-ai-selloff-and-us-tariff-fears), [Journal Arta](https://journalarta.com/en/2026/11/25/asia-stocks-today-nikkei-and-asx-200-rise-as-nasdaq-futures-slide/)

## Singapore

**PM Lawrence Wong said Singapore will facilitate US checks to stop it being used as a conduit for chip export-control circumvention, while upholding its own laws.** The US added seven firms to its Entity List, three based in Singapore, and the Section 301 list now names Singapore too, so trade-hub risk premia are rising. — [Malay Mail](https://www.malaymail.com/news/singapore/2026/11/25/pm-wong-singapore-will-help-us-enforce-chip-curbs-but-uphold-its-own-laws/244640), [The Independent SG](https://theindependent.sg/from-server-investigations-to-new-us-chip-rules-how-singapore-got-here)

## VC and Tech

**Asian rounds were small: Chinese quantum startup Atomqubic raised an angel round above RMB 100 million co-led by Legend Star and Shanghai Future Industry Fund, and Hong Kong's OpenVault closed a $2 million seed led by HorizonArc for digital asset yield.** Both come from aggregator roundups, so treat them as direction. Asia startup funding was $38.5 billion in Q3 per Crunchbase data, near a record, with AI taking most capital. — [Tech Startups](https://techstartups.com/2026/11/25/startup-funding-news-today-november-25-2026-zipher-peak-energy-atomqubic-dante-security-more/), [Techloy](https://www.techloy.com/week-47-asia-startup-funding-megarobo/)

Next 48h: Thu 26 Nov US markets closed for Thanksgiving, thinning liquidity; Fri 27 Nov US markets close at 1 p.m. ET; Section 301 hearings reportedly begin 25 Jan 2027.

Content angle: Wednesday showed how thin liquidity can print a 3% crash and a full recovery inside one session, while bitcoin got no such rebound because its seller is a slow ETF holder. Volatility is a mood; flows are a decision.
"The S&P fell 3.2% and closed flat. Bitcoin fell and stayed down. One was panic, the other was people quietly leaving. Learn to tell a scare from an exit."
